title: Cost-Efficient Large Language Model Serving for Multi-turn Conversations with CachedAttention (formerly AttentionStore), USENIX ATC 2024
supports: Multi-turn KV caches saved to a hierarchical host-DRAM/SSD store and reloaded on resume; scheduler-aware fetching uses job-scheduler hints to prefetch KV from disk into host memory; layer-wise preloading; claims up to 87% TTFT cut. Prior art for I-08555/I-01659/I-07651; no client typing-signal prefetch seen (via search snippet)
